NOT `STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS`, history hydration or any stored-part path (seat ruling Q2 = A, live only), and nothing under `skills/**`, `docs/adr/**` or `.claude/**`. Stop on breach and explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:thread`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates.mjs --tier: "no path-derived mandate"`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: an ask turn that carries one `data-draft-review` part renders one card under that assistant message, with one row per draft (label or name, type, a verdict badge: will publish / N problems / verdict withheld) and a Review link to `review.item`, one "Review and publish" link per package to `review.changes`, and "+N more" for `omitted`. The card has no publish and no discard control. A malformed part renders nothing and does not crash; a turn without the part renders exactly as today. Strings are in every locale pack, links carry accessible names, and no locale overflows. Seat ruling on the shape: `verdict.refusals` / `advisories` reuse `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` arrays from `@objectstack/spec/api`, since that is what the door's `list_drafts` verdict returns (`runtime mcp-authoring.ts:405-414`). The thread posts the final part shape on this card before merge, so cloud#5172 follows it, as the card asks.
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds, measured on origin/main 0e90d2f9. The chat reads only `data-chart` (`toolResultParsers.ts:172`, allow-list :324-332) and `data-record-citations` (`mapMessages.ts:267`). Nothing under `ui/` renders a `save_metadata_draft` / `list_drafts` result outside tests. The build chat front end retired by #37720 (with its `DraftReview` type) is not revived or reused. Full report: `/mnt/project-files/card-38048/pre-claim-report-0e90d2f9.md`.
